rules: Run registered CLI Discovery and use its declared safe help invocation before invoking a retained Bemoat command.
CLI help is read-only and changes no GitHub, branch, or local workflow state.
Context is read-only; Handoff records evidence but does not authorize a new objective or grant approval.
Only one bounded objective may execute at a time; durable result and Handoff precede fresh Context and authorization for the next objective.
STOP and FOUNDER_GATE are human-owned boundaries; no autonomous merge, approval, or invented authority.
Assert a specific route only when canonical authority uniquely determines it.
Where authority only forbids an outcome, assert the exclusion without inventing a fallback.
Where multiple outcomes remain plausible, classify SPEC_GAP and stop before encoding a route.

writes: exactly one top-level Issue HANDOFF comment; no other protocol mutation

authorization_per_objective: fresh registered CLI Discovery and Context for A
durable A result, required HANDOFF, then fresh Context before B
durable B result, required HANDOFF, then fresh Context before C
durable C result, required HANDOFF, then fresh Context before D
prohibited: advance based on session memory, labels, or a prior objective's authorization
treat HANDOFF as permission or approval
continue through STOP or FOUNDER_GATE without the separately required authority

exclude: assume STOP or FOUNDER_GATE from label alone
choose VERIFY, REVIEW, FIX, or STOP from label alone
claim spawned-host PASS without native continuity evidence

required: all repositories, refs, evidence fixtures, traces, and cleanup targets are test-owned disposable resources
preserve original checkout and unrelated refs/WIP
no production GitHub mutation or writes outside the owned sandbox
cleanup removes only resources created and owned by this run
retain sanitized trace evidence after cleanup
verify ownership and post-cleanup absence before reporting cleanup success
